method: Independent read-only source/decompiled-C/original objdump instruction review; no executable, renderer or frame edits. This is control/arithmetic review, not a full Windows paint or retained-frame behavioral proof.

checks.detail: BPP12, width8 and height10 queried in original order. Width upper-clips1280; height upper-clips768. Signed width<=800 chooses wrapped height-30; otherwise signed trunc(height/17) then wrapped subtraction. Source preserves signed I32 boundary behavior.

FILD signedI32 clippedheight, multiply exact binary64 constant4cc3d8, FSTP binary64 at50f6e0. Then signedI32 original/clippedwidth4f4084 times4cc3e0, FSTP binary64 at5259d0. Float80 reproduces this arithmetic under inherited CW027f.
Original INC wraps signed32 before comparison>60/reset1; source add32 implements the same result including INT_MAX.

Independent state0 then state1 branches remain separate, and state/results/forecast/view/tutorial globals reload after real child calls. Results>0 branch can precede later dispatch only if its child makes the reloaded results state0. Mode3/4/5 chart calls and final nonnegative nonzero tutorial dispatch preserve the original branch order.

Restore flag2 beep/write occurs before independent flag1 restore. Tick/cursor capture then wind, five wind-patch expiry checks, dynamically bounded boat-AI loop, player1 steering, conditional player2, boat dynamics, optional integration, two independently reloaded snapshot conditions, and sequential stage1..6 checks are preserved.

Gate-dependent distance threshold60/110 is cached once like original local10. Every stage reloads its current stage and timer globals after distance/save children. Timer+5 uses signed32 wrap, then signed comparison. Stage4..6 executes only layouts2/4/5/6/7. Gate state and final reset/retention cases match the original branches.

Three top-level composition branches are independent and reload human/view modes after children. One-human split:scene→optionalpause→chart/advice→chart→HUD. One-human view3:scene→optionalpause→chart→optionalpause→HUD. Two-human:scene2→optionalpause→scene1→optionalpause→chart2→compact2→chart1→compact1. Local inset/left/right remain cached across child calls where original registers do; later dimensions reload.

Negative divisions truncate towardzero; doubled/fivefold widths use wrappedI32 multiplication before /3 or /6. Source imul32/idiv32/sub32 corresponds to original LEA/IMUL magic-division sequences, not floating fractions.

Level>=7 skips endtick;6waits30ms,5waits60ms, lower waits80ms. Unsigned32 tick delta and JAE/JB comparisons match u32 subtraction. Final4f7124/4f7128 I32zero stores occur after all composition and waiting.

Bitmap height/clientheight stays cached for BitBlt; current width reloads. Afterwards bitmap reselection/deletion precedes current-height rectangle construction and independent two invalidation conditions. Actual Windows object allocation/SEH destruction lifetime belongs to the supplied host contract.

nonBehavioralStoreOrderObservation.original: MOV4fe2a8 at404601 precedes FSTP50f6e0 at404607 and FSTP5259d0 at404619
nonBehavioralStoreOrderObservation.effect: For the reviewed finite single-thread observational host domain, no child/API callback or relevant intervening read occurs, so final state and drawing requests are unchanged. This is an exact store-order difference, not a demonstrated behavior failure.
nonBehavioralStoreOrderObservation.resolution: Owner corrected calibration write order to original client-height I32 store followed by the two F64 stores. Original evidence is retained above; no behavior difference was demonstrated.

limits: Full Windows/MFC allocation, exception and surface raster lifetime is explicitly owned-host scope. No native full-paint proof is claimed by this read-only review.

Per-boat frame counters are JSNumber increments rather than explicit signed32 wraps. Supported original UI fleet counts max30 make them equivalent; original corrupt INT_MAX fleet states would access invalid boat storage long before the counter wraps.
The source timing host includes an explicit1,000,000-read stalled-clock guard; original native loop has no such bound. Normal browser paintClock and bounded native observation ticks do not reach it.
GetCursorPos failure/uninitialized native stack states and arbitrary reentrant child callbacks are outside this finite explicit host contract.
The decisive broad behavioral check remains exact retained initialized original frame replay after renderer source regeneration.
